newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECHS BEAT CANADA 5-3 AT WORLD ICE HOCKEY CHAMPS.
newsitem.headline: CZECHS BEAT CANADA 5-3 AT WORLD ICE HOCKEY CHAMPS.

text.p: The Czech Republic beat Canada 5-3 in their medal round match at the World ice hockey championships in Helsinki on Wednesday.
Leading 3-2 after the second period, the Czechs widened the gap when Vladimir Vujtek completed his hat trick with a goal in the first minute of the final frame.
Rostislav Vlach then put the Czechs up 5-2 in the ninth minute, before Canada's Bob Sweeny scored with just under 10 minutes left in the game.
